baselineDetailScope: four paired seeds x 50 years; old eight-century JSON lacks individual promotion ages; no extrapolation
politicalQualification: unchanged source: legal unique live 1-4 member formation; original career/crisis requirements remain; service-only junior promotion is not political eligibility
limitations: Recent appointees are included in the observed promotion ratio; it is not a lifetime probability.
Service-duration counts include ended appointments; active unpromoted cases are reported separately.
Siege/promotion association is descriptive, not a causal estimate. Only commander-verified unique actual siege starts are counted, never collision callback counts.
No active siege without an ending source is credited as an effective siege; short contact and commands earn no military activity.
The same appointment/city contributes at most one qualifying activity. Captured siege endings do not duplicate the actual capture merit.
